# Empire State Bulldogs
> Premium French Bulldog and English Bulldog breeder based in New York. Health-tested, champion bloodlines, family-raised puppies. Founded and owned by Vaughn.

Empire State Bulldogs, owned and operated by Vaughn, is a premier bulldog breeder in New York specializing in French Bulldogs and English Bulldogs. All puppies are raised in a family home environment, health-tested, and come with a comprehensive health guarantee. We offer stud services, nationwide puppy shipping, and detailed breed education.

## Available Puppies

- [Puppies](https://www.empirestatebulldogs.com/puppies): Browse currently available French Bulldog and English Bulldog puppies — color, gender, and health details listed for each pup

## Key Facts

- French Bulldogs and English Bulldogs
- Family-raised, socialized from birth
- Health-tested parents — OFA, DNA panels
- Nationwide shipping available
- Champion and rare-color bloodlines
- Based in New York
